description: This source file defines various placement classes for distributed tensor sharding in PyTorch, including Shard, Replicate, and Partial placements, along with utility methods for tensor splitting, unpadding, padding, and collective operations. It specifically implements logic for sharding tensors across device meshes, including advanced patterns like strided sharding.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: Implements tensor sharding placement over a specific device mesh dimension, with methods for splitting, unpadding, padding, reduction, and converting between shard and replicate formats.

classes.name: _StridedShard
classes.description: Supports complex 2D sharding patterns like right-to-left sharding using strided indexing, including tensor splitting, converting to replicate, and local shard size computation.

classes.name: Replicate
classes.description: Indicates replication of tensor across a device mesh dimension, supporting broadcast operations.

classes.name: Partial
classes.description: Defines pending reduction operations over a device mesh dimension, including logic for reducing, partitioning, and redistributing tensors.

classes.name: _MaskPartial
classes.description: Specialized partial placement for masked embedding operations, handling mask creation, application, and reduction.

methods.description: Splits a tensor into shards along the placement's dimension, with optional padding to ensure equal size.

methods.description: Returns a single shard from the tensor split, based on index, with optional padding and cloning.

methods.description: Computes local shard size and offset for a given number of chunks and rank.
